message.content: {"caption":"Diagram contrasting a manually engineered traditional generalist-agent system with Alita’s self-evolving, MCP-based approach.","description":"A two-part comparison diagram. In the upper section, a traditional generalist-agent manager connects to specialized tools or agents, including a URL text extractor, image captioner, relevant patch zoomer, web agent, path generalist classifier, other agents, and a YouTube caption crawler. Large-scale manual engineering is associated with incomplete coverage, limited creativity and flexibility, and mismatch. Below a dashed divider, Alita (Ours) shows a web agent and manager agent connected to an MCP box through MCP creation and self-evolving processes. The lower approach highlights minimal predefinition and maximal self-evolution, leading to scalable dynamic capability, enhanced creativity and flexibility, and cross-ecosystem compatibility.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
